dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single prominent, thick white horizontal band visible on the wing coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark gray wing background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp pale-colored edges are visible along the outer boundaries of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, high-contrast white patch visible at the center of the posterior nape at the base of the crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and sharp linear boundary between the black crown and the yellowish-green upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large high-contrast white cheek patch; bird is holding a dark, oblong seed or object in its beak.
